text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering the library, I saw Sakura Laurel 
with a French reference book open before 
her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? How far did I study up to?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Umm... "emprunter" means "to borrow"... 
right. And "représenter" is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Sakura Laurel hasn't fully 
recovered from her race fatigue. We need 
to reconsider our race schedule.
